subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should `agent.request` gain an explicit opt-in media relay from Node attachments to outbound IM delivery, or should those attachments remain agent/model input only?
rationale: The next step changes a security-sensitive Gateway-to-channel delivery contract and could send untrusted node media through credentialed IM accounts without agent-authored media, so automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary safely.

options.title: Approve explicit relay contract
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in `agent.request` field or API with target authorization, channel capability checks, size/type limits, audit logging, and agent override or suppression semantics.

options.title: Keep agent-authored delivery
options.body: Keep Node attachments as model input only and require the agent, message tool, reply payload, or direct-send surface to attach media outbound.

options.title: Route dumb relays elsewhere
options.body: Document or extend an existing node/direct-send/plugin workflow for camera-style relay use cases without changing `agent.request` fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit relay contract
recommendation.body: Add an explicit opt-in `agent.request` field or API with target authorization, channel capability checks, size/type limits, audit logging, and agent override or suppression semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest recent history match across node agent dispatch, gateway attachments, agent delivery, and security-related contributor ownership.
